verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no explicit no-training policy or training opt-out for the managed service. The only route is indirect: self-hosted/BYOC deployment, which keeps "your data, models, and infrastructure under your control," plus single-tenant and regional options, so data need not reach the vendor at all. missing for 10: explicit statement that customer data is not used for model training, a documented opt-out for the managed SaaS tier, data-retention/usage terms, independent corroboration.
